CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2024 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108
  AND
  23, NO. 61, LANE 208, RUI'AN STREET,
  DA’AN DISTRICT, TAIPEI CITY, TAIWAN 106

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

AGENDA – DECEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 1 of 5
   Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00
  p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council at
  the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
  module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-
  person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant
to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting
agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on
duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  ELECTION

 1.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-24-33 CERTIFYING THE
  NOVEMBER 5, 2024, ELECTION RESULTS

AGENDA – DECEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 2 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council accept the official canvass of the
  General Municipal Election held on November 5, 2024, and adopt Resolution No. R-
  24-33 declaring the results. If Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to accept the official canvass of the General Municipal Election and Special
  Municipal Election held on November 5, 2024, and adopt Resolution No. R-24-33
  declaring the results thereof.”

  CEREMONIAL

2.  PRESENTATION OF CITY TILES TO, AND REMARKS FROM, OUTGOING
  CITY COUNCIL MEMBER STEVE TALT

3.  PRESENTATION OF CITY TILES TO, AND REMARKS FROM, OUTGOING
  CITY COUNCIL MEMBER AND MAYOR, STEVEN W. HUANG

4.  OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY ELECTED MEMBER OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL HUNTER CHANG

5.  OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY ELECTED MEMBER OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL JOHN CHOU

6.  REMARKS FROM NEWLY ELECTED COUNCIL MEMBERS

7.  REORGANIZATION OF THE CITY COUNCIL BY SELECTING A MAYOR
  AND VICE MAYOR

8.  REMARKS FROM THE NEWLY APPOINTED MAYOR

  CONSENT CALENDAR

9.  APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE AGREEMENT WITH DUDEK
  FOR PROFESSIONAL DESIGN SERVICES FOR THE CULVERT
  REPLACEMENT PROGRAM EXTENDING THE TERM THROUGH DECEMBER
  31, 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve Amendment No. 2 with
  Dudek extending the term of the Professional Design Services Agreement through
  December 31, 2025. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Amendment No. 2 with Dudek extending the term of the
  Professional Design Services Agreement for the Culvert Replacement Program through

AGENDA – DECEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 3 of 5
   December 31, 2025, and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on
  behalf of the City.”

10. APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 2 WITH ECONOMICS, INC. FOR SOLID
  WASTE CONSULTING SERVICES EXTENDING THE TERM THROUGH
  DECEMBER 31, 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No.
  2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Economics, Inc. for solid waste
  consulting services extending the term through December 31, 2025. If the Council
  concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with
  Economics, Inc. for solid waste consulting services extending the term through
  December 31, 2025 and authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment on
  behalf of the City.”

11. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF OCTOBER 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of October
  2024.”

12. RECEIVE AND FILE  MONTHLY  DISBURSEMENTS  REPORT  FOR
  NOVEMBER 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of November 2024. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of
  November 2024.”

13. SCHEDULED VACANCIES FOR COMMISSIONS, COMMITTEES, AND
  BOARDS FOR CALENDAR YEAR 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council accept and file the Local
  Appointments List for all City commissions, committees, and boards for calendar year
  2025, and direct the City Clerk to post the list.

14. APPOINTMENT OF ADVISORY BODY MEMBER TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY
  COMMISSION

  Recommendation: The Council Liaisons for the Public Safety Commission recommend
  the Council appointment of one (1) full member to serve a partial term commencing
  on December 12, 2024.

  If Council concurs, the appropriate motions would be:

AGENDA – DECEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 4 of 5
   “I move to appoint Brian Davis as a full member of the Public Safety Commission to
  serve a partial term to end on May 31, 2026.”

 15. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the October 2024 minutes.
  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the regular meeting of November 13, 2024, and
  the adjourned regular meeting of November 20, 2024.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: 12/06/2024  ALISON WALKER
  CITY CLERK
